segments.say: A boy just woke a sword that could *kill* him, and a six-star werewolf is about to regret it.
Jin Runcandel is deep inside a camp of *terrorists*, and he just cut a girl named Mesa free.
At the top of the stairs stands a giant white *werewolf*.
He smashes Mesa aside with one *blow*.
Jin answers, I am the son of Ciaron *Runcandel*.
The werewolf laughs. Then you will be my most prized *prey*.
His name is Quazito Truka, a six-star monster born for *slaughter*.
He offers a deal. Fight with *honor*, or run and get torn to pieces.
Jin raises his sword, and it gets *ugly*. This guy hits like a freight *train*.
Magic cannot pierce that hide, so there is one *option* left. Awaken the sword.
Small problem. Murakhan warned him the overload could *kill* him.
The werewolf lifts his hammer. It is over, *cub*!
Light explodes, and the werewolf screams that he cannot *see*.
The full story is on our channel.
